metadata.description: Emvigo QA mobile toolkit: Flutter test cases from real-device Appium exploration, Appium execution with reports, and Jira bug filing

plugins.name: em-qa-mobile
plugins.description: Builds mobile test cases (CMP, INT, E2E, UI, MOB) for Flutter apps from docs, a test plan and Appium exploration on a real device; executes them with WebdriverIO + TypeScript + Appium, updates MD/XLSX results, files genuine bugs with recordings and device logs, writes the test report, and files bugs into Jira.
